facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on P-3222 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 7 May 2018 a potential incident was recorded on P-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
